end

Missing values and exceptions

title: In a test suite
Getting Started
text: This page walks through a complete validation workflow: defining checks, running them, and acting on the results.

title: The workflow
text: Using CheckMate always takes three steps: Define a CheckSet with the @checkset macro.Run it against your data with run_checkset, which returns a CheckSummary.Inspect the summary, either by reading the printed report or by querying it with functions such as failed_checks and failing_rows.

title: 1. Write validation functions
text:
A validation function takes one value per column and returns a Bool: true when the row is valid and false when it is not. is_positive(x) = x > 0
valid_currency(x) = x in ("USD", "EUR", "GBP")

title: CheckMate.jl
text: Declarative, row-level data validation for tabular data in Julia.
